title: Provide a reusable fixture-driven component clipping harness for visual proof
goal: PROBLEM: Layout fixes need headless proof that no text is clipped (jsdom cannot measure layout), but the repo offers only whole-app capture (scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs needs a running app URL) and one-off inline snippets (a page-level scrollWidth check in canary-e2e/tests/mobile-responsive.spec.js; a jsdom width assertion in LogViewer.test.jsx). There is no reusable way to render one component with fixture props plus repo tailwind at stated widths, assert scrollWidth <= clientWidth per selector, and emit PNG proof to the task docs folder. On the alias redo the implementation agent skipped the required Step 6 screenshots entirely, and the reviewer had to hand-roll a scratch vite server on 127.0.0.1:4173 with fixture data to measure per-chip clipping - the exact ad-hoc-background-server pattern stage guidance forbids. Skipped proof plus hand-rolled harnesses doubles review effort on every visual task. FIX: Add a reusable headless component clipping harness (script + doc): renders a target component with JSON fixture props and repo tailwind at given widths (e.g. 1440 and 390), fails on any clipped target selector (scrollWidth vs clientWidth) and on page horizontal overflow, writes PNG captures defaulting to docs/tasks/<task-id>/ with PNG-magic self-verification following capture-screenshot.mjs conventions, and never requires a long-lived server. Document it in the Testing & Verification guidance; acceptance is reproducing the alias desktop+mobile no-clipping proof with one command per width. Case study: task 158394ab-3b43-4813-b94a-32d772a79972 (docs/tasks/158394ab-3b43-4813-b94a-32d772a79972/: IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md Step 6, review-alias-redo-20261120.md visual-evidence section).
